record: C7 Stage 2 — execution decision, locked before any cell completed

verified_at_authoring.why_this_matters: the decision is recorded while NO C7 Stage-2 datum exists, so runtime cost cannot have been traded against a result

the_decision: run C7 Stage 2 exactly as frozen, to completion, with no amendment

the_discretion_this_closes.what_was_proposed_and_rejected: let the first cell complete to obtain a measured per-cell time, THEN decide whether to amend the episode count
the_discretion_this_closes.why_it_was_wrong: once a cell completes, scientific C7 data exist. Amending sampling afterwards -- even for an honest runtime reason -- is post-data discretion, which is precisely the pattern this project has spent every gate eliminating. Prudence about cost is not a licence to decide after seeing data.
the_discretion_this_closes.the_clean_alternative: if a sampling amendment were wanted, the only admissible moment was BEFORE the first cell. That moment is now, and the answer is no amendment.

why_not_to_sample_the_response_space.the_cost_driver: legal team responses per state rose from mean 6.7 (max 9) at 2v2 to mean 57.0 (max 81) at 4v4, roughly 8.5x more 30-step branches per state
why_not_to_sample_the_response_space.the_argument_against_sampling: that explosion is itself a property of the treatment: 4v4 dramatically enlarged the strategic response space. Sampling it now would convert the decisive C7 test into a different experiment measuring a different space.
why_not_to_sample_the_response_space.runtime: on the order of 40 hours for the 4v4 arm, extrapolated from branch counts rather than measured. No measured figure will be used to revisit this decision.

why_stage_2_is_now_MORE_important_not_le.not_supported: the predicted allocation-loosening mechanism. The like-for-like offence/contest correlation barely moved: -0.9229 at 2v2 to -0.9149 at 4v4.
why_stage_2_is_now_MORE_important_not_le.unknown: whether a preference reversal exists at 4v4
why_stage_2_is_now_MORE_important_not_le.reading: that unknown is the entire remaining value of C7. Stopping now would leave three 1M-step 4v4 training runs having answered nothing about strategic demand.

the_two_pre_committed_readings.REVERSAL_FOUND: 4v4 generated strategic demand even though the proposed offence/contest mechanism was not supported. We proceed to confirmation, then the trained-conditional gate, then observability -- and we do NOT claim to know why the reversal appeared.
the_two_pre_committed_readings.NO_REVERSAL: doubling team size produced competent policies and exceeded the preregistered capacity metric, but did not support the proposed allocation-loosening mechanism and did not demonstrate a preference reversal. Team-size work then STOPS entirely: no 6v6, no revised capacity ruler, no opponent patch. SRCTF becomes the main line.

the_descriptive_finding_worth_keeping_ei: 4v4 expanded the combinatorial allocation/response space by ~8.5x while leaving the measured offence/contest tradeoff essentially unchanged. Stage 2 tests whether that additional choice space contains real strategic opportunity cost, or merely more ways for one generalist to do the same job.
